preconditions.description: The length of the string P must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The number of queries Q must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'chef' for c in P)
preconditions.description: The string P must only contain the characters 'c', 'h', 'e', and 'f'.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L <= R <= len(P) for L, R in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, L and R must be valid indices within the bounds of the string P.

preconditions.expression: all(a != b for a, b, _, _ in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, the characters a and b must be different.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(count_good_strings(P, a, b, L, R))
postconditions.description: The output for each query must be the count of good strings starting with character a and ending with character b within the specified range.
